summary.en-US: Filter X by your following network, hide marked promoted posts, and count blocked posts.

description.en-US: Keep posts by your direct follows and optionally their follows, using locally supplied/reviewed lists. Optionally hide detected promoted posts. See cumulative blocked posts and an ads breakdown for this tab since reload or Reset. Local-only; no analytics, account actions or automatic full-graph download. Prototype: selectors and actual X layouts can change; current live X and Firefox runtime are not yet verified.

version.approval_notes: Readable JavaScript/CSS/HTML; no bundler. Matching source attached. Build with Python 3.10+ using python build.py. Output: dist/firefox. No npm install required for the build. See docs/REVIEWER-NOTES.md. Requires a logged-in X session for main functionality; reviewer access must be supplied privately in AMO, never in public source.
